semiconductor_relevance: High — ProbeLeader Co., Ltd specializes in semiconductor testing equipment and services, making it a key player in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: ProbeLeader Co., Ltd focuses on the design and assembly of semiconductor wafers and IC Turn Key testing accessories. With over 20 years of experience, the company provides high-quality probe cards and customized test solutions for various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Manufacturing of high-power, high-frequency, and fine pitch probe cards
Development of semiconductor AOI defect inspection equipment
Custom test carrier board design including A/D mixed-signal packages
Provision of semiconductor consumables such as polishing fluid and thermocouples

regional_presence.China: The company operates three factories in Hsinchu, Pudong, and Wuxi, focusing on manufacturing and assembly.
